treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Macedonia and Romania for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2000)
eif_quote: Art. 29(1): The Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day after the date of the latter notification ... and its provisions shall have effect: (i) in respect of taxes withheld at the source to the income derived on or after the first day of January in the calendar year next following the year in which the Convention enters into force; | UJP table: Romania | 7/2002 | 16.08.2002 | 01.01.2003
source_title: UJP English text of the MK-Romania convention (27Romania.pdf)

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (no PPT clause in treaty; MLI not applicable: North Macedonia signed the MLI on 2020-01-29 but has not ratified it)

notes: Art. 11(3): interest derived by the other Government, local/administrative-territorial units, their agencies, banks or institutions, or on debt-claims guaranteed/insured/financed by a wholly state-owned financial institution, exempt at source (not modelled). Replaces the 1986 Romania-SFRY convention.
